source.directorySummary: Provides web rendering for the file view command, combining code-view stylesheet and WebNodeRoot construction for displaying, highlighting, copying, and inline-editing file content with breadcrumb and timeline integration.

stylesheet.ts.sourceSummary: Defines and exports filePluginViewStylesheet WebStyleSheet with CSS for read-only and editable code views, line numbers, and injected breadcrumb/timeline styles.

web.ts.sourceSummary: Exports renderFileViewWeb to build the file view WebNodeRoot with breadcrumb, timeline button, highlighted code lines with clipboard/scroll handling, toggleable editableText, and edit/diff toolbar actions.

enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf web-presentation sublayer of the view command, decoupled from handler.ts validation and bounded-read execution. Completes the shared validate-containment → execute → CLI/web-adapt lifecycle by owning all style and WebNodeRoot generation for previews, allowing handler.ts to remain transport-agnostic and adapter.ts/handleFile routing to stay centralized. Bridges filesystem-ops read results to appweaver-web primitives (code-view, breadcrumb, timeline) without leaking rendering concerns into the broader 20-command container.

files.stylesheet.ts: Static style dependency for its sibling web.ts — not imported outside this directory except transitively via renderFileViewWeb. Isolates all visual concerns for the view's web adaptation so markup generation stays style-agnostic, supporting the read-only/editable code-view split and injected breadcrumb/timeline overrides.
files.web.ts: Web-branch renderer invoked exclusively by parent view/handler.ts; builds the WebNodeRoot response that handler returns to adapter.ts for dispatch. Composes filePluginViewStylesheet with highlighted line rendering, clipboard/scroll handling, and toggleable editableText plus edit/diff toolbar actions to connect read-only preview output to workspace editing and history affordances.
